articles.title: This sanctioned Russian stablecoin claims it processes billions, but blockchain analysts disagree
articles.snippet: A7A5 claims crypto data providers understate its trading activity, while blockchain analytics firms say the ruble-backed token's volumes have fallen sharply this year.

articles.title: Ether and solana extend gains as a short squeeze lifts bitcoin toward $62,000
articles.snippet: Bearish traders lost $281 million in liquidations over 24 hours, nearly double the longs, as bitcoin pushed to its strongest level in two weeks. Ether is up almost 10% on the week and solana nearly 19% while a rebound in tech stocks eased the pressure from the AI trade.

articles.title: Securitize tokenizes $295 million of its own stock on Solana and Avalanche amid NYSE debut
articles.snippet: The newly-public company's shares are the largest issuer-sponsored tokenized stock at launch, aiming to make a point against rival third-party stock token issuers.

articles.title: StanChart joins ESMA's first MiCA register update since deadline
articles.snippet: ESMA publishes its first post-deadline MiCA register update, adding 37 crypto-asset service providers, including Standard Chartered and FalconX.

articles.title: Securitize gains on NYSE debut with tokenized stocks live on Solana, Avalanche
articles.snippet: Securitize has issued tokenized versions of its shares on Solana and Avalanche, marking the first time a newly public company has done so on its debut.
